title: Ahengua a Etutuu Akwantuo Wɔ Ahɔhoɔ
intro: Obi a ɔwɔ tumi kɛse dii adefo ahenni bi a wɔde ahonyade a ɛboro so ahyira no so. Bere a asɛnnennen bi a na wɔnhwɛ kwan sɔree no, ɛnyɛ nkrante sodifo yi hyiaa sɔhwɛ na mmom nyansa ne gyidi. Nea ɛbɛda adi no bɛma afi wiase tumi a ɛkorɔn no mu akɔ koma mu nsakrae a emu dɔ mu.
clues: Midii ahenni bi a ahonyade ne yiyedi a wontumi nsusuw ho ahyira so so
Ná meyɛ ɔhene a ɔwɔ tumi a me nsa kaa krataa a ɛyɛ akokoduru a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ mebrɛ me ho ase
M’anuonyamfo tuu me fo sɛ ebia me ne ɔhene a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri yi bɛko anaasɛ mɛsiesie asomdwoe
Mede akyɛde ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa sii kwan so sɛ m’ankasa merekɔhyia ɔhene a ɔwɔ akyirikyiri yi
Wɔde m’ahemfie ahengua no baa asase bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri so wɔ aniwa mu, ansa na meresan aba
Bere a mehyɛn ahemfie bi a ne fam yɛ torotoro te sɛ ahwehwɛ mu no, awiei koraa no, mebɔɔ ​​me ho ase maa Allah ho dawuru

outcome.answer: Ahobrɛaseɛ ma Allah wɔ nkɔmhyɛni bi nkyɛn

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
